newsitem.title: KAZAKHSTAN: Kazakh parliament may discuss 1997 budget Dec 18.
newsitem.headline: Kazakh parliament may discuss 1997 budget Dec 18.

text.p: Kazakhstan's parliament is likely to discuss the 1997 budget during a joint session of both chambers on December 18, the speaker of the Mazhilis lower chamber said on Wednesday.

"By approving a number of economic laws in November we cleared the way for 1997 budget discussions," Marat Ospanov told a news conference, adding he expected budget debates to be agitated because of the tough economic situation in the former Soviet republic.
The Mazhilis earlier this month approved laws on currency control, the budget system, taxes and other compulsory payments to the budget.
In October Economy Minister Umirzak Shukeyev said the government was planning a budget deficit in 1997 of three percent of gross domestic product.
